findings.title: Chicago-Area Mothers Struggle to Find Care as Labor and Delivery Units End Services
findings.exact_supporting_passage: On Saturday, the maternity ward at Roseland Community Hospital, a safety-net hospital on Chicago’s Far South Side, shut its doors.
findings.access_consequences: Roseland Community Hospital suspended its labor and delivery unit effective October 31, 2026. Patients seeking full obstetric care must use another hospital; WTTW identifies Trinity Hospital more than four miles away as the nearest full maternal care location. Hospital emergency rooms without delivery units typically stabilize obstetric emergencies and transfer as necessary.
findings.affected_population: Pregnant patients and families served by Roseland Community Hospital and surrounding South Side Chicago communities, including low-income and Black maternal-care populations described in the report.
